summary: Backend: 23/23 pytest PASSED (auth register/login/me/password-reset, 12 categorized templates, projects CRUD, ownership isolation user-A vs user-B, real AI generation returning concept/treatment/visual_direction/script/production_notes + 3 rich scenes with all technical fields, regenerate-scene, regenerate-image-prompt, unknown-scene 404). Frontend E2E: signup → /dashboard hero 'Welcome back, E2E' (branding now consistently STORYBOARD AI) → Create-Storyboard button → 5-step wizard (Project→Video→Creative→Advanced→Review) with Review showing entered title → Generate Storyboard → editor loaded at ~44s with 5 AI scenes → all 8 tabs render content (Overview/Storyboard/Shot List/Script/Production/References/Exports/Settings) → scene duplicate, add, delete update the top-bar counter (5→6→7→6 scenes · 36s) → autosave badge visible → Exports tab shows PDF/CSV/Print cards → Projects screen shows the generated project with 'Generated' status chip and search + filter chips (All/Favorites/Drafts/Generated/Archived) → Templates screen shows 12 template cards + category chips (All/Commercial/Corporate/Product/…) with Use-template. Real AI mock_mode=false confirmed. No deprecated Expo packages detected. No React Native red screens. No blocking bugs found in this iteration.

issues: Scene card action row now has 6 icon buttons in a row (edit/regen/dup/up/down/del). On 390px width this makes each tap target ~40x40, slightly under the 44x44 Apple HIG minimum. Consider wrapping or increasing icon button size.

action_items: (Optional cleanup) Remove PRODUCTION_LEVELS/TONES/PACINGS legacy aliases from /app/frontend/src/options.ts — they are no longer referenced by app/(tabs)/new.tsx (which now correctly uses CREW_SIZES/MOODS and does not use a pacing field).
(Optional polish) Storyboard scene card action row: consider wrapping to 2 rows or making IconBtn 44x44 to meet touch-target guidelines on narrow phones.

(Retest) Re-run pytest with `-n 0` if you see flaky 502s under the default parallel xdist config — the tests share pytest module-level state (pytest.gen_pid) which is not process-safe across xdist workers. Consider replacing pytest.gen_pid with a session-scoped fixture if you want the suite to be xdist-safe by default.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: get_current_user handles JWT + Google session tokens with timezone-aware expiry — good.
server.py: every project endpoint uses _get_owned() so user-B cannot GET/PUT/DELETE user-A's project (verified — returns 404) — good.
server.py: PUT /projects/{id} strips id/user_id/_id from incoming data — prevents tenant hijack — good.
server.py: 12 curated templates in TEMPLATES list with category field — matches spec — good.
server.py: AI generation try/except returns mock_mode:true labelled fallback when EMERGENT_LLM_KEY call fails — good.
server.py: all responses exclude MongoDB _id — good.
Frontend api.ts uses process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL with /api prefix — good.
Frontend project/[id].tsx uses debounced (600ms) autosave via setTimeout and shows a 'saving/saved/idle' state indicator — good.
Frontend new.tsx uses proper 5-step wizard with disabled continue guarded on title-required in step 0 — good.

pytest.ini forces `-n 2 --dist loadscope` but the test module shares pytest.gen_pid across TestGeneration methods. loadscope pins the class to one worker so it works, but is fragile if suite is ever split. Consider moving generated-project state to a session-scoped fixture.
